pairs: In tempore illo dixit Dominus ad me:
“At that time, the Lord said to me:
‘Hew for yourself two tablets of stone,
et ascende ad me in montem:
and ascend to me on the mountain.
And you shall make an ark of wood.
et scribam in tabulis verba quæ fuerunt in his qui ante confregisti:
And I will write on the tablets the words which were on those that you broke before,
and you shall place them in the ark.’
Feci igitur arcam de lignis setim.
And so, I made an ark of setim wood.
Cumque dolassem duas tabulas lapideas instar priorum,
And when I had hewn two tablets of stone like the former,
And he wrote on the tablets,
according to that which he had written before,
quæ locutus est Dominus ad vos in monte de medio ignis,
which the Lord spoke to you on the mountain from the midst of fire,
And he gave them to me.
and placed the tablets in the ark,
and they are still there even now,
just as the Lord instructed me.
Filii autem Israël moverunt castra ex Beroth filiorum Jacan in Mosera,
Then the sons of Israel moved their camp, from Beeroth among the sons of Jaakan,
ubi Aaron mortuus ac sepultus est,
into Moserah, where Aaron died and was buried,
pro quo sacerdotio functus est Eleazar filius ejus.
and where his son Eleazar was installed in the priesthood in his place.
they set out and camped at Jotbathah,
in a land of waters and torrents.
At that time, he separated the tribe of Levi,
so that he would carry the ark of the covenant of the Lord,
et staret coram eo in ministerio,
and stand before him in the ministry,
ac benediceret in nomine illius usque in præsentem diem.
and speak blessings in his name, even to the present day.
Quam ob rem non habuit Levi partem,
Levi has no portion or possession with his brothers.
quia ipse Dominus possessio ejus est,
For the Lord himself is his possession,
sicut promisit ei Dominus Deus tuus.
just as the Lord your God promised him.
Then I stood on the mountain,
exaudivitque me Dominus etiam hac vice,
And the Lord heeded me at this time also,
and he was not willing to destroy you.
quam juravi patribus eorum ut traderem eis.
which I swore to their fathers that I would deliver to them.’
quid Dominus Deus tuus petit a te,
nisi ut timeas Dominum Deum tuum,
what does the Lord your God require of you?
Only that you fear the Lord your God,
ac servias Domino Deo tuo in toto corde tuo,
and serve the Lord your God with your whole heart and with your whole soul,
and that you keep the commandments of the Lord,
which I am instructing to you this day,
so that it may be well with you.
En Domini Dei tui cælum est,
Lo, heaven belongs to the Lord your God,
et omnia quæ in ea sunt:
and all the things that are within these.
et tamen patribus tuis conglutinatus est Dominus,
Now the Lord was closely joined to your fathers,
and he chose their offspring after them,
just as is being proven today.
Therefore, circumcise the foreskin of your heart,
et cervicem vestram ne induretis amplius:
and no longer stiffen your neck.
quia Dominus Deus vester ipse est Deus deorum,
For the Lord your God himself is the God of gods,
He accomplishes judgment for the orphan and the widow.
et dat ei victum atque vestitum.
and he gives him food as well as clothing.
et ipsi fuistis advenæ in terra Ægypti.
for you also were new arrivals in the land of Egypt.
You shall fear the Lord your God,
and him alone shall you serve.
and you shall swear by his name.
Ipse est laus tua, et Deus tuus,
He is your praise and your God.
qui fecit tibi hæc magnalia et terribilia,
He has done for you these great and terrible things,
In septuaginta animabus descenderunt patres tui in Ægyptum,
As seventy souls, your fathers descended into Egypt. And now,
et ecce nunc multiplicavit te Dominus Deus tuus sicut astra cæli.
behold, the Lord your God has multiplied you to be like the stars of heaven.”
